title: Ocean County Residents Face Serious Charges for Drug Distribution - NewsBreak
text:
1 hours ago Ocean County Residents Face Serious Charges for Drug Distribution — According to theOcean County Prosecutors Office, Detectives from the Ocean County Prosecutor's Office Narcotics Strike Force collaborated with the Seaside Heights Police Department, Ocean County Sheriff’s Office K-9 Unit, and Asbury Park Police Department, to conduct an extensive investigation into the distribution of illegal narcotics in the Ocean County area. This month-long cooperative multi-agency investigation identified a residence in Seaside Heights as being utilized by Leo Johnson, 50, and Michelle Karcher, 46, both of Seaside Heights, to store and distribute methamphetamine, cocaine, fentanyl, and ecstasy pills.
